contract: Play MP4 tx3g and Matroska UTF-8, ASS/SSA or WebVTT to EOF through Player and TextBridge. Compare with live av_read_frame of the pinned FFmpeg formats build and, for tx3g, its mov_text decoder.

Fold each cue's presentation and duration clocks in microseconds, with an explicit unknown marker, then its text. A Matroska text track compares source with source: the candidate folds the cue's Block data and the bytes of its type-1 BlockAdditional, the reference the packet data and the type-1 BlockAdditional side data av_read_frame returns, decoding nothing. MP4 tx3g compares display text with display text, because the reference has no source text view: the reference decodes with mov_text and projects the ASS Text field by resolving line and space escapes and removing override blocks; the candidate writes every line terminator of ETSI TS 126 245 section 5.11 (CR LF, CR, LF, NEL, U+2028, U+2029) in the decoded string as LF.
Preload the container on both sides. Opening and reading the container, the tx3g decode, folding and teardown are inside the operation.

open_deviations.reading: BOM-marked UTF-16 tx3g text decodes to Unicode scalars
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.1: terminals shall correctly decode both UTF-8 and UTF-16, and a UTF-16 string begins with the byte order mark.
open_deviations.candidate: Returns the decoded text: c385e6b0b40ac3a9, 41e6b0b4, f09f988041 and 41; in r-subtitle-tx3g the UTF-16 cue e7b582 at 3000000 us and, by the empty-string rule, a zero-byte cue at 1000000 us.
open_deviations.reference: The mov_text decoder reads the UTF-16 bytes as UTF-8, logs an invalid UTF-8 byte and publishes no event for these samples; every other sample agrees.
open_deviations.compat: triergon_subtitles::compat::mov_text::Decoder, which converts tx3g samples to the events of the reference's mov_text decoder

open_deviations.reading: A NUL inside the counted tx3g string is a character, not its end
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.17: the string is text-length bytes and there is no need for null termination; section 5.3: a control character with no defined graphical behaviour is not displayed and does not move the rendering position.
open_deviations.candidate: Keeps the NUL and the text after it: 610062, 007461696c and 610a62000a0a0a (a LF b NUL and three line breaks from NEL, U+2028 and U+2029).
open_deviations.reference: Ends the displayed string at the first NUL: 61, an empty string and 610a62.
open_deviations.compat: triergon_subtitles::compat::mov_text::Decoder, which converts tx3g samples to the events of the reference's mov_text decoder

open_deviations.reading: A lone CR in tx3g text starts a new line
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.11: LF, U+2028 and U+2029 shall start a new line; CR, NEL and CR LF should.
open_deviations.candidate: Displays a LF b LF c LF d (610a620a630a64) for the source a CR LF b CR c LF d.
open_deviations.reference: Drops the lone CR and joins b and c: 610a62630a64.
open_deviations.compat: triergon_subtitles::compat::mov_text::Decoder, which converts tx3g samples to the events of the reference's mov_text decoder

open_deviations.reading: Braces and backslashes in tx3g text are characters, not ASS markup
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.17 holds the text as characters and sections 5.17.1.1 onwards carry styles as modifier boxes; the format has no inline markup.
open_deviations.reference: Passes the characters into its ASS event unescaped, so {\b1} becomes an override and \N a line break: A LF B LF C LF (410a420a430a).
open_deviations.compat: triergon_subtitles::compat::mov_text::Decoder, which converts tx3g samples to the events of the reference's mov_text decoder

open_deviations.reading: A font name in the sample description does not change the sample's text
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.16 names fonts for the style records; the text of a sample is its section 5.17 string.
open_deviations.candidate: Returns abcdef for each of the 13 samples.
open_deviations.reference: Writes the font name into the ASS override unescaped, so Sp ace,{x} leaves a literal brace (a}bcdef at 4000000 us), and publishes no event for the samples at 14000000, 18000000 and 22000000 us whose font names (ff fe, A U+FFFE, a truncated c3) are not UTF-8.
open_deviations.compat: triergon_subtitles::compat::mov_text::Decoder, which converts tx3g samples to the events of the reference's mov_text decoder

open_deviations.reading: A noncharacter is a valid scalar in well-formed text
open_deviations.clause: Unicode Corrigendum #9 and RFC 3629 sections 3 and 4: noncharacters such as U+FFFE are well-formed UTF-8 and may be interchanged; ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.1 requires UTF-8 decoding.
open_deviations.reference: Logs invalid UTF-8 and publishes no event for the sample.
open_deviations.compat: triergon_subtitles::compat::mov_text::Decoder, which converts tx3g samples to the events of the reference's mov_text decoder

open_deviations.reading: A known zero source duration remains a value
open_deviations.clause: ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 section 8.6.1.2 stores sample deltas, zero included; RFC 9559 section 5.1.3.5.3 defines an explicit BlockDuration in Track Ticks.
open_deviations.candidate: Reports duration 0 (known) for the cues a, a and zero.
open_deviations.reference: Reports the duration as unknown: AVPacket.duration 0 means unknown, so a known zero cannot be carried.

open_deviations.reading: A negative Matroska Block time is kept
open_deviations.clause: RFC 9559 section 11.2: the Block timestamp is signed, it SHOULD NOT be negative, and a frame with a negative timestamp MUST be decoded but not played.
open_deviations.candidate: Returns the Block at -715000 us with duration 333000 us.
open_deviations.reference: Returns the same Block and duration with PTS 0.

open_deviations.reading: The unsigned stts delta of 4294967295 ticks is kept
open_deviations.clause: ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 sections 8.6.1.2.2 and 8.6.1.2.3: sample_delta is an unsigned 32-bit count.
open_deviations.candidate: Reports 4294967295000000 us for the 4294967295-tick sample at one tick per second.
open_deviations.reference: Reports 1000000 us after clipping the delta to one tick.

open_deviations.reading: A zero-byte ASS Block is a packet
open_deviations.clause: RFC 9559 section 10 frames each Block's data by the element size and sets no minimum frame size.
open_deviations.candidate: Returns a zero-byte cue at 0 with duration 0.
open_deviations.reference: The demuxer returns no packet for the zero-byte Block.

open_refusals.reason: Byte-reversed UTF-16 tx3g text is not read
open_refusals.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.1: terminals are not required to recognise byte-reversed UTF-16 (a string beginning FF FE).

open_policies.policy: An empty tx3g string is reported as a zero-byte cue
open_policies.undecided: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.17 allows a text-length of 0 and does not say whether a player publishes an event for it; TextBridge reports every sample as a cue.
open_policies.rule: Emits a zero-byte cue for each empty sample: at 0 (1001000 us and 1500000 us), at 0 before b, at 0, 21334 and 2621334 us in fragmented-subtitles and at 0 and 2600000 us in fragmented-subtitle-edit; every nonempty cue agrees.
open_policies.reference_rule: The mov_text decoder publishes no event for an empty string.
open_policies.compat: triergon_subtitles::compat::mov_text::Decoder, which converts tx3g samples to the events of the reference's mov_text decoder

open_policies.policy: A size-0 modifier box extends to the end of its sample
open_policies.undecided: ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 section 4.2 defines size 0 only for the last box of a file, whose contents extend to the end of the file; ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.17 does not define it inside a sample. Extractor::tx3g_iso_boxes reads it as extending to the end of the sample.
open_policies.rule: Keeps the text abcd and x, and a at 0 followed by b at 1001000 us.
open_policies.reference_rule: Refuses the sample with a size-0 box (tsmb_size invalid) and publishes no event for it; b at 1001000 us agrees. It accepts the 64-bit size form.
open_policies.compat: triergon_subtitles::compat::mov_text::Decoder, which converts tx3g samples to the events of the reference's mov_text decoder

open_policies.policy: Triergon refuses a tx3g sample whose text is shorter than its length
open_policies.undecided: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.17: text-length counts the bytes of the string that follows.
open_policies.rule: Refuses the sample with Truncated and publishes nothing for it; later samples are read.
open_policies.reference_rule: Publishes the bytes present as the text: xy, ab and xy.
open_policies.compat: triergon_subtitles::compat::mov_text::Decoder, which converts tx3g samples to the events of the reference's mov_text decoder

open_policies.policy: Triergon refuses a tx3g sample with a malformed modifier box
open_policies.undecided: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.17 fills the rest of the sample with modifier boxes; ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 section 4.2 gives each box a size of at least its header and within its container.
open_policies.rule: Refuses the sample with Truncated for an incomplete header or a box past the sample and publishes nothing for it; later samples are read.
open_policies.reference_rule: Publishes the text for an incomplete header or an overrunning box: x, abcd, abcd, x and a.
open_policies.compat: triergon_subtitles::compat::mov_text::Decoder, which converts tx3g samples to the events of the reference's mov_text decoder

open_policies.policy: Triergon refuses a tx3g string that is not well formed in its encoding
open_policies.undecided: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.1 requires UTF-8 or BOM-marked UTF-16; RFC 3629 sections 3 and 4 exclude overlong forms, surrogates and incomplete sequences.
open_policies.rule: Refuses the sample with Invalid and publishes nothing for it; later samples are read. In capsule-mov-text-nul-invalid-tail that is its one sample, a NUL followed by a byte that is not UTF-8; in capsule-mov-text-tags-nul-transitions it is sample 9 (ab NUL ff d) at 18000000 us, and the other 13 samples keep the NUL and the text after it.
open_policies.reference_rule: Ends the text at its first NUL, so the bytes after it are not decoded: a in capsule-mov-text-nul-invalid-tail; in capsule-mov-text-tags-nul-transitions ab for each sample, ending at its NUL, through 24000000 us.
open_policies.compat: triergon_subtitles::compat::mov_text::Decoder, which converts tx3g samples to the events of the reference's mov_text decoder

open_policies.policy: Triergon refuses Matroska UTF-8 text with a scalar above U+10FFFF
open_policies.undecided: Matroska codec mappings draft 21 section 3.5.11 carries S_TEXT/UTF8 as UTF-8 text; RFC 3629 section 3 limits UTF-8 to U+10FFFF.
open_policies.rule: Refuses the Block with Invalid (invalid Unicode scalar) and publishes nothing for it.
open_policies.compat: none: no compat item reproduces the reference's rule

open_policies.policy: Triergon refuses a WebVTT BlockAdditional without its identifier line
open_policies.undecided: Matroska codec mappings draft 21 section 5.4.4: the type-1 BlockAdditional holds the cue settings, a LF, the cue identifier, a LF, then comments.
open_policies.rule: Refuses the Block with Truncated and publishes nothing for it.
open_policies.reference_rule: Returns the Block body and its 41-byte type-1 addition (align:start LF and an unterminated identifier); it does not interpret the addition.
open_policies.compat: none: no compat item reproduces the reference's rule
